AboutPage.title: About me
AboutPage.metaDescription: Full-stack engineer with 5+ years building distributed systems, AI tools, and scalable products. Based in Germany.
AboutPage.bio1: I got into programming not through some career plan, but out of a romantic pull toward startup culture — partly inspired by the sitcom Silicon Valley. I'm a geek, I love technology, and that's why I decided to build my life around it. It's just the creative nature of being human.
AboutPage.bio2: For my career achievements — impact numbers, case studies, what I have actually shipped — see the %%HOME%% and %%PROJECTS%%.
AboutPage.bio4: My current focus is on the intersection of distributed systems and AI — building things that are fast, reliable, and actually solve business problems. I write occasionally on %%LINKS%% — the last article got 5K+ views.

gallery.intro: Outside of engineering: chess, cycling, hiking, Lindy Hop dance, and Historical European martial arts. I've mentored 4 developers and translated the React Redux docs into Russian.

tinderBios.about-019: Chased the fog up an Austrian mountain just to see what was on the other side. I do that with problems too — pays off more often than not.
tinderBios.about-028: Just came down from climbing Snezka and I'm still buzzing. Good with mountains, bugs, and knowing when a hike (or a first date) needs a hut stop.
tinderBios.about-055: Taking selfies with 7-ton bronze heads is a normal Tuesday for me. Bring your own icebreakers, I've clearly got mine covered.
tinderBios.about-067: Bought this bike for 30 euros and it's the best investment I've made all year. Soft spot for a good deal and an even better forest trail.
tinderBios.about-087: I clean up nicely for the theater — turns out engineers can do black tie too. Ask me about the show, or don't, I'll talk about it anyway.
tinderBios.about-091: Grew this mustache as an experiment. Verdict: mixed reviews, zero regrets. I commit to bits the same way I commit to shipping code.

travelMap.title: Where I've been
travelMap.subtitle: I've spent my whole conscious life in just two cities — Moscow and Chemnitz — and given them a lot of my time. But it's time to move forward: I now live in Berlin, I'm finishing my Master's in Web Engineering at Chemnitz University of Technology, and the next goal is German citizenship.

Contact.title: Hire me!
Contact.metaDescription: Get in touch — open to engineering roles, freelance work, and technical collaboration.
Contact.subtitle: Open to new opportunities, technical collaboration, and interesting conversations.

faqHr.a: Based in Chemnitz, Germany. Open to roles across Germany, the EU, UK, US, UAE, Canada, Singapore, Japan, South Korea, and Australia — remote-first works too.
Currently full-time at Infineon Technologies — happy to discuss timing once there's mutual interest.

faqHr.q: Are you open to contract or freelance work?
faqHr.a: Yes — short-term consulting and technical leadership engagements are welcome alongside full-time roles.

faqTech.a: Go, Python, and TypeScript/React in production, with Kafka, ElasticSearch, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Kubernetes underneath. Increasingly working with RAG, LangChain, and MCP on the AI side.

faqTech.q: Do you have production on-call experience?
faqTech.a: Yes — I've built and operated services handling real traffic at Infineon and OZON Tech, including Kubernetes deployments monitored with Prometheus and Grafana.

faqTech.q: How do you approach architecture decisions?
faqTech.a: Trade-off driven, documented as ADRs — see the Decisions page for real examples from past projects.

faqTech.q: Can I see your code or side projects?
faqTech.a: Check the Skills page for an interactive breakdown of my stack, or Projects for full case studies.

faqBusiness.q: Can you work directly with a non-technical founder?
faqBusiness.a: Yes — at WeDo.agency I shipped 9 startup projects working directly with founders, translating business goals into technical scope.

faqBusiness.q: How do you scope an MVP?
faqBusiness.a: I focus on the smallest slice that proves the business hypothesis, then iterate — happy to walk through trade-offs openly.

faqBusiness.q: Are you open to fractional or part-time engagements?
faqBusiness.a: Yes — open to discussing scope, time commitment, and rates directly.

faqBusiness.q: What kind of ROI have you delivered?
faqBusiness.a: €480K/year in savings at Infineon, €86K at OZON Tech, and an 11.63% metric uplift at onlineTours — see the Impact Dashboard for details.
